name: Genocide
overview: The Scriptures record instances where God commanded the Israelites to engage in the complete destruction of certain peoples, as seen when He instructed them to drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, and others (Exodus 34:11), and to slay every man, woman, and child in specific cities (Deuteronomy 2:34). These divine commands were executed with precision, reflecting God's sovereign judgment and purpose in establishing His covenant people. However, God also set boundaries, as with the children of Ammon, whom He commanded not to be harmed (Deuteronomy 2:19), demonstrating His control over the scope of these judgments.
